description: Verify that the system identifies known hazards.
expected_output: The system correctly identifies all known hazards in the input data.
steps: Input the list of known hazards into the system.
Verify that the system has identified all known hazards in the input data.
Review the system's output to ensure that it matches the expected output.

description: Verify that a hazard analysis is written
expected_output: Hazard analysis document exists and is complete
steps: Check if the hazard analysis document exists in the specified location.
Verify that the hazard analysis document contains all required elements (e.g., process flow diagram, potential hazards, controls, monitoring procedures).
Confirm that the hazard analysis document is up-to-date and has been reviewed by a qualified person.

description: Verifies that the system can identify and prevent biological hazards.
expected_output: System identifies and prevents biological hazards in sample food product.
steps: Input a sample food product into the system.
Verify that the system identifies potential biological hazards in the sample food product.
Verify that the system takes appropriate actions to prevent biological hazards from contaminating the food product.
notes: <Assumptions: The system has been properly configured and is functioning as intended.>

description: Assess severity and probability of hazard occurrence
input_data: Hazard identification report, risk assessment report, and process flow diagram for a food processing facility
expected_output: A table that lists all identified hazards, their severity level, and probability of occurrence
steps: Review the hazard identification report to identify all potential hazards associated with the food processing facility.
Use the risk assessment report to determine the likelihood of each hazard occurring.
Use the process flow diagram to map out the steps in the food processing facility and identify any potential points where the identified hazards could occur.
notes: Assumptions: The hazard identification report, risk assessment report, and process flow diagram are accurate and up-to-date. Special conditions: None.

description: Evaluate environmental pathogens for ready-to-eat foods
expected_output: Identification of environmental pathogens in the ready-to-eat food samples
steps: Obtain ready-to-eat food samples from production line
Perform microbiological analysis to detect environmental pathogens
Compare the results with FDA guidelines for environmental pathogen detection in ready-to-eat foods
notes: Assumptions: The microbiological analysis is performed using validated methods and equipment. The FDA guidelines are up-to-date and applicable to the type of food being tested.
